description: React Native / Expo — native iOS and Android from React. Registered because the `react` descriptor serves web runtimes only (react/nextjs/remix): without this row a React Native consumer resolved to web React and was handed DOM components. metadata_only — the contract, tokens and rules apply, the source is the consumer's to write.
name: React Native
tier_note: First-class native target. Keeps its own idiomatic UI over the shared Rust core.
